info.title: DssHarness
info.description: Cross-platform repository harness CLI: git worktree management with Windows path-budget checks, driven entirely by .harness-config/config.json.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: DssHarness - cross-platform repository harness. Run 'DssHarness help' for reference material.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

commands.name: init
commands.description: Create .harness-config with its configuration, worktrees and ssh directories, and ignore rules.

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Show detailed progress and child process output. [default: False]

options.name: --directory
options.description: Directory to operate in (default: current directory).

commands.name: verify-git
commands.description: Check that git is installed and this directory is a git repository (0 ok, 1 no git, 2 not a repository).

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Show detailed progress and child process output. [default: False]

options.name: --directory
options.description: Directory to operate in (default: current directory).

options.name: --random
options.description: Generate the name instead of supplying one; the chosen name is reported. [default: False]

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Show detailed progress and child process output. [default: False]

options.name: --directory
options.description: Directory to operate in (default: current directory).

arguments.name: NAME
arguments.description: Worktree name: lowercase letters and digits joined by hyphens; at most 10 characters unless worktrees.maxNameLength says otherwise.

commands.name: delete-worktree
commands.description: Remove a worktree and everything under it; refuses one holding work that would be lost, or a locked one, without --force.

options.name: --force
options.description: Delete the worktree without checking it, even when locked: uncommitted changes, commits on no branch, tag, remote-tracking ref, newest stash or other worktree's HEAD, and submodules' unpushed work are lost. [default: False]

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Show detailed progress and child process output. [default: False]

options.name: --directory
options.description: Directory to operate in (default: current directory).

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Show detailed progress and child process output. [default: False]

options.name: --directory
options.description: Directory to operate in (default: current directory).

commands.name: write-anchor
commands.description: Add a new anchor: to the pending registry, or to the done registry when its status is closed.

options.name: --priority
options.description: P0, the most urgent, to P5.

options.name: --trigger
options.description: What is wrong, and what would make it worth doing now.

options.name: --status
options.description: open, gated, disclosed or closed. A closed anchor is filed in the done registry. [default: open]

options.name: --closing
options.description: What remains to be done to close it.

options.name: --cross-refs
options.description: Where it is cited, and related anchors.

options.name: --anchor-dry-run
options.description: Show the anchor and where it would be filed, and write nothing. [default: False]

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Show detailed progress and child process output. [default: False]

options.name: --directory
options.description: Directory to operate in (default: current directory).

arguments.name: ID
arguments.description: The new anchor's id, for example D-AREA-TOPIC-DETAIL.

commands.name: set-anchor
commands.description: Change an existing anchor. Changing its status moves it between the pending and done registries.

options.name: --pending
options.description: Look for the anchor in the pending registry only. [default: False]

options.name: --done
options.description: Look for the anchor in the done registry only. [default: False]

options.name: --priority
options.description: A new priority: P0, the most urgent, to P5.

options.name: --status
options.description: A new status: open, gated, disclosed or closed. Closing an anchor moves it to the done registry; any other status moves it back to pending.

options.name: --trigger
options.description: Replace the Trigger cell.

options.name: --closing
options.description: Replace the Closing work cell.

options.name: --cross-refs
options.description: Replace the Cross-refs cell.

options.name: --anchor-dry-run
options.description: Show the change, and write nothing. [default: False]

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Show detailed progress and child process output. [default: False]

options.name: --directory
options.description: Directory to operate in (default: current directory).

commands.name: read-anchor
commands.description: Show anchors in full by id. Ids not found are listed, and the exit code is then 1.

options.name: --pending
options.description: Look in the pending registry only. [default: False]

options.name: --done
options.description: Look in the done registry only. [default: False]

options.name: --json
options.description: Write the anchors found as a JSON array. [default: False]

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Show detailed progress and child process output. [default: False]

options.name: --directory
options.description: Directory to operate in (default: current directory).

arguments.name: IDS
arguments.description: One or more anchor ids, matched exactly.

commands.name: read-anchors
commands.description: List anchors by priority, status and id, or check the registries with --lint.

options.name: --pending
options.description: List the pending registry only. [default: False]

options.name: --done
options.description: List the done registry only. [default: False]

options.name: --band
options.description: Only these priorities, for example --band P0 P1.

options.name: --open
options.description: Only anchors that are not closed. [default: False]

options.name: --closed
options.description: Only closed anchors. [default: False]

options.name: --json
options.description: Write the list, or the lint findings, as JSON. [default: False]

options.name: --lint
options.description: Check both registries in full instead of listing: malformed rows, misfiled anchors and duplicate ids. The exit code is 1 when there are problems. Takes none of the listing filters. [default: False]

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Show detailed progress and child process output. [default: False]

options.name: --directory
options.description: Directory to operate in (default: current directory).

commands.name: check-anchor-balance
commands.description: Fail when a change leaves more open anchors than it found, or a registry is misfiled or malformed.

options.name: --base
options.description: The commit to compare with. [default: HEAD]

options.name: --json
options.description: Write the receipt as JSON. [default: False]

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Show detailed progress and child process output. [default: False]

options.name: --directory
options.description: Directory to operate in (default: current directory).

commands.name: legs
commands.description: Measure the hosts and show where each leg can run, or why it cannot. Runs each emulator's witness, and installs or updates DssHarness on hosts that are behind.

options.name: --legs
options.description: Only these legs or leg sets: --legs a,b or --legs a b. Without it, every declared leg.

options.name: --json
options.description: Write where each leg runs, and every host measured, as JSON. [default: False]

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Show detailed progress and child process output. [default: False]

options.name: --directory
options.description: Directory to operate in (default: current directory).

commands.name: host-exec
commands.description: Run a DssHarness command on a WSL distribution or an ssh host, in that host's copy of the repository, installing or updating DssHarness there first when it is behind.

options.name: --ssh
options.description: Run on this ssh host, declared under hosts.ssh.

options.name: --wsl
options.description: Run in this WSL distribution, declared under hosts.wsl; with no name, WSL's default distribution.

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Show detailed progress and child process output. [default: False]

options.name: --directory
options.description: Directory to operate in (default: current directory).

arguments.name: COMMAND
arguments.description: The DssHarness command to run there, with its arguments. Put -- before it, so its options stay its own.

commands.name: help
commands.description: Explain exit codes, configuration, legs and hosts, worktrees, anchors and layout.

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Show detailed progress and child process output. [default: False]

options.name: --directory
options.description: Directory to operate in (default: current directory).

arguments.name: TOPIC
arguments.description: Topic to explain: exit-codes, config, legs, worktrees, anchors, layout. Omit for an overview.

commands.name: host-agent
commands.description: Serve one request from the DssHarness on another machine: a line of JSON on standard input, which stays open while it is served.

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Show detailed progress and child process output. [default: False]
